checks.name: all component House test suites
checks.command: for test_dir in $(find house -type d -name tests -print | sort); do python3 -m unittest discover -s "$test_dir" -p 'test_*.py'; done

checks.name: static checks
checks.command: python3 -m compileall -q house/relay && ruff check changed files && ruff format --check changed files && git diff --check

claim_ceiling: A deterministic static composition of two supplied frozen index documents. It does not invoke their renderers or read their backing state; it does not refresh/bind a listener, create/mutate/dispatch tasks, contact workers/providers, start a viewer, launch a browser, call iTerm, accept terminal input, grant authority, or open a reverse channel.
